query: (document excerpt)
result: 劃分日期、月份、季與年度 | 解讀: 所有期間篩選（年、季、月）都必須先把 UTC 時間戳加 8 小時再切分。
validation_method: 文件引文，搭配 ev_tz_month_shift 量化影響

query: SELECT COUNT(*) n, SUM(strftime('%Y',order_ts)<>strftime('%Y',datetime(order_ts,'+8 hours'))) year_shift, SUM(strftime('%Y-%m',order_ts)<>strftime('%Y-%m',datetime(order_ts,'+8 hours'))) month_shift FROM orders WHERE status IN (1,2,3)
result: {"columns": ["n", "year_shift", "month_shift"], "rows": [[47993, 86, 523]]} | 解讀: 86 張有效訂單換年、523 張換月；時區換算會實質影響月、季、年度彙總。
validation_method: 比較 UTC 與 UTC+8 的年月切分差異筆數

query: SELECT strftime('%Y',datetime(order_ts,'+8 hours')) y, COUNT(*) n, SUM(status IN (1,2,3)) valid FROM orders GROUP BY 1
validation_method: 依台北年度分組計數

query: SELECT status, COUNT(*) n FROM orders GROUP BY status ORDER BY status
validation_method: distinct 值檢查

query: (document excerpt)
result: 訂單狀態為「已付款、已出貨、已送達」的訂單 | 解讀: 有效訂單 = status 1,2,3。
validation_method: 文件引文，搭配 ev_valid_has_ok_payment 驗證

query: SELECT o.status, COUNT(*) n, SUM(ok_cnt=1) one_ok, SUM(ok_cnt=0) zero_ok, SUM(ok_cnt>1) multi_ok FROM orders o JOIN (SELECT o2.order_id, SUM(CASE WHEN p.payment_status='ok' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) ok_cnt FROM orders o2 LEFT JOIN payments p ON p.order_id=o2.order_id GROUP BY o2.order_id) x ON x.order_id=o.order_id GROUP BY o.status
validation_method: 依訂單狀態統計成功付款筆數分佈

query: SELECT COUNT(*) total_rows, SUM(payment_status='failed') failed_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) distinct_orders FROM payments
result: {"columns": ["total_rows", "failed_rows", "distinct_orders"], "rows": [[61319, 13326, 53976]]} | 解讀: 61319 列付款僅對應 53976 張訂單，13326 列為失敗；實收金額須只計 ok。
validation_method: 比較付款列數、失敗列數與不重複訂單數

query: SELECT COUNT(*) n, MIN(i.unit_price_cents*1.0/p.list_price_twd) minr, MAX(i.unit_price_cents*1.0/p.list_price_twd) maxr, SUM(i.unit_price_cents/100.0 > p.list_price_twd) above_list FROM order_items i JOIN products p ON p.product_id=i.product_id
result: {"columns": ["n", "minr", "maxr", "above_list"], "rows": [[104966, 80.0, 100.0, 0]]} | 解讀: 金額換算為 TWD 需除以 100；成交價為標價的 80%~100%，符合含折扣說明。
validation_method: 成交單價與標價比值檢查

query: (document excerpt)
result: 成交單價是客人實際付的價格（已含折扣與優惠碼），不是商品目錄上的標價。 | 解讀: 商品金額 = quantity × unit_price_cents / 100 (TWD)，不得用 list_price_twd。
validation_method: 文件引文，搭配 ev_payment_reconcile 對帳

query: SELECT COUNT(*) n, SUM(ABS(pay.amt-it.amt)<1) match_exact, SUM(pay.amt>it.amt) pay_gt, SUM(pay.amt<it.amt) pay_lt FROM (SELECT order_id, SUM(amount_twd) amt FROM payments WHERE payment_status='ok' GROUP BY order_id) pay JOIN (SELECT order_id, SUM(quantity*unit_price_cents)/100.0 amt FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id) it ON it.order_id=pay.order_id
result: {"columns": ["n", "match_exact", "pay_gt", "pay_lt"], "rows": [[47993, 47993, 0, 0]]} | 解讀: 47993/47993 張完全吻合；優惠碼折扣已內含於成交單價，不應再扣一次。
validation_method: 訂單層級對帳 payments(ok) vs order_items

query: SELECT o.coupon_code, COUNT(*) n, AVG(pay.amt*1.0/it.amt) ratio FROM orders o JOIN (SELECT order_id, SUM(amount_twd) amt FROM payments WHERE payment_status='ok' GROUP BY order_id) pay ON pay.order_id=o.order_id JOIN (SELECT order_id, SUM(quantity*unit_price_cents)/100.0 amt FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id) it ON it.order_id=o.order_id GROUP BY o.coupon_code
result: {"columns": ["coupon_code", "n", "ratio"], "rows": [[null, 33585, 1.0], ["SUMMER15", 7350, 1.0], ["WELCOME10", 7058, 1.0]]} | 解讀: NULL、SUMMER15、WELCOME10 比值皆為 1.0。
validation_method: 依優惠碼分組比較付款/明細比

query: (document excerpt)
result: 期間依「訂單成立時間」歸屬，退款扣回它所屬的原訂單，不看退款發生在哪個月。 | 解讀: 淨營收 = 期間內有效訂單商品金額 − 這些訂單的退款(不論退款時間)。
validation_method: 文件引文，搭配 ev_refund_cross_period 驗證存在跨期退款

query: SELECT strftime('%Y',datetime(o.order_ts,'+8 hours')) order_year, strftime('%Y',datetime(r.refund_ts,'+8 hours')) refund_year, COUNT(*) n, SUM(r.refund_amount_twd) amt FROM refunds r JOIN orders o ON o.order_id=r.order_id GROUP BY 1,2
validation_method: 依訂單年度與退款年度交叉彙總

query: (document excerpt)
result: 依「退款發生時間」歸屬期間，與淨營收的歸屬方式不同。 | 解讀: 退款金額類題目（C15,C16,C17,C28）以 refund_ts 的台北時間切期間；C17「歷史上」不限期間。
validation_method: 文件引文

query: SELECT o.status, COUNT(*) n, SUM(r.refund_amount_twd) amt FROM refunds r JOIN orders o ON o.order_id=r.order_id GROUP BY o.status
result: {"columns": ["status", "n", "amt"], "rows": [[3, 4039, 18071770]]} | 解讀: 4039 筆退款全在 status=3；扣回淨營收時無需另外過濾訂單狀態。
validation_method: 退款依訂單狀態分組

query: SELECT COUNT(*) n, COUNT(DISTINCT r.item_id) distinct_items, SUM(r.order_id<>i.order_id) order_mismatch, SUM(r.refund_amount_twd > i.quantity*i.unit_price_cents/100.0) over_refund, AVG(r.refund_amount_twd*100.0/(i.quantity*i.unit_price_cents)) avg_ratio FROM refunds r JOIN order_items i ON i.item_id=r.item_id
result: {"columns": ["n", "distinct_items", "order_mismatch", "over_refund", "avg_ratio"], "rows": [[4039, 4039, 0, 0, 0.8463702250440032]]} | 解讀: 平均退款約為明細金額 85%；可透過 item_id 連到 products 取得商品類別（C17,C18）。
validation_method: 退款與明細對帳

query: SELECT p.category, r.reason_code, COUNT(*) n, SUM(r.refund_amount_twd) amt FROM refunds r JOIN order_items i ON i.item_id=r.item_id JOIN products p ON p.product_id=i.product_id WHERE r.reason_code='R2' GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY amt DESC
result: {"columns": ["category", "reason_code", "n", "amt"], "rows": [["tent", "R2", 293, 2875457], ["shoes", "R2", 365, 1992215], ["backpack", "R2", 296, 1185567], ["apparel", "R2", 343, 899198], ["accessory", "R2", 324, 330147]]} | 解讀: 各類別皆有 R2 退款，類別來源為 products.category。
validation_method: 依類別彙總 R2 退款
